race.comment: Tricky race but HE'S REGAL (4) ticks a few boxes on debut. He's a colt by Zoustar who was an expensive yearling purchase for the Price & Kent Jnr yard. Blake Shinn goes on from an ideal draw and he's won a jumpout leading in. Should go well. EKTIFIRE (7) resumes having last tackled the G3 Magic Night Stakes, well beaten there but thought highly enough of to have a crack. She can be an improver this time around. MYSTICAL REALM (10) is a Maurice filly for the Maher yard who won a recent trial at Caulfield Heath and should be ready to go. Respecting support for MASOCHISTIC (9) for the Clinton McDonald yard off sound jumpout form, when the money comes for the stable it's usually accurate.
